name: control-panel-access-platform-administration
executionConcern: operator access, shell, BFF, platform and administration security controls
objective: Close operator access, shell, BFF, platform and administration security controls end to end without losing canonical ownership, authorization, readback or directly affected surface compatibility.
truthOwner: Identity owns operator authentication/session; DSH owns operational policy/configuration; authorization and trusted scope are enforced server-side.

tasks.objective: Establish fail-closed operator session and route/object authorization
tasks.currentProblem: Session, route and object checks can diverge across shell, hidden routes, BFF and server code.
tasks.requiredChange: Unify access decisions on server-authoritative Identity/permission/trusted-scope context for all Control Panel routes.
tasks.targetState: Direct URL, navigation and API access share the same fail-closed authorization semantics.
tasks.action: Trace shell/API/server boundaries; correct the earliest authority divergence; add focused tests for expired session, forbidden route, wrong object and actor change.
mustNotChange: Do not create parallel domain truth or client-trusted authorization context.
Do not broaden execution into repository areas without a proven Control Panel dependency.
Do not weaken audit, idempotency, conflict or canonical-readback guarantees to make the UI appear successful.
acceptanceCriteria: Direct URL, navigation and API access share the same fail-closed authorization semantics.
Forbidden/wrong-scope and dependency/error states fail explicitly rather than fabricating success.
State-changing actions are verified by canonical readback and directly affected surfaces where applicable.
tasks.rollback: Revert the focused implementation commit or roll forward at the canonical owner while preserving audit/data evidence; never restore parallel truth.
tasks.commitBoundary: One focused U001 implementation commit after owner correction, affected-consumer migration, cleanup and linked checks.

tasks.objective: Close Platform/Administration policy, role, audit and rollback controls
tasks.currentProblem: High-impact configuration and administration writes can affect authorization or platform behavior across sections.
tasks.requiredChange: Make sensitive writes object-authorized, scope-safe, audited, conflict-aware and canonically re-readable.
tasks.targetState: Roles, actor state, policies/configuration and rollback actions cannot bypass audit/scope or leave ambiguous state.
tasks.action: Trace administration/platform screens to DSH/Identity owners; correct mutations and readback; ensure search/bulk actions validate each target.
